_doc: ARO Data Engine registry. Every dataset ARO may touch is listed here. commercial_status: allowed | conditional | eval_only | rag_only | restricted | excluded | unverified. Only 'allowed' datasets with 'train' usage and a recorded license check may enter training data; 'eval' data never enters training; 'rag' sources are for retrieval at answer time.

datasets.name: FineWeb
datasets.redistribution: ODC-By; underlying web pages keep their own copyright
datasets.notes: Only for continued pretraining (not planned yet). Web content rights and CommonCrawl terms apply.

datasets.name: Dolma
datasets.notes: Pretraining corpus; underlying content rights vary by source.

datasets.name: OpenAssistant Conversations (oasst1)
datasets.notes: Superseded by oasst2 (which includes it).

datasets.name: OpenAssistant Conversations (oasst2)
datasets.quality: human-written, human-ranked; synthetic rows filtered out
datasets.notes: ARO 1.5 starter data (aro_training.bootstrap).

datasets.name: Aya Dataset
datasets.notes: Key source for African-language conversation.

datasets.name: Tulu 3 SFT Mixture
datasets.redistribution: ODC-By overall; subsets carry their own licenses
datasets.notes: Mixture includes subsets generated by commercial models whose terms forbid training competing models. Only individually cleared subsets may be used — not the whole mixture.

datasets.name: UltraChat 200k
datasets.notes: MIT tag, but the dialogues were generated with ChatGPT; OpenAI terms forbid using outputs to build competing models. Do not train on it.

datasets.name: No Robots
datasets.notes: Non-commercial license.

datasets.name: Wikimedia Dumps (Wikipedia etc.)
datasets.attribution: Attribute Wikipedia contributors; share-alike for redistributed text
datasets.notes: Best as a RAG knowledge source with citations. Training use: legal review of share-alike obligations first.

datasets.name: The Stack
datasets.license: other (BigCode terms of use; per-file permissive licenses)
datasets.redistribution: Terms of use; honour opt-out removals
datasets.notes: Gated. Requires accepting terms and keeping up with opt-out removals.

datasets.name: The Stack v2
datasets.notes: Gated; contents fetched from Software Heritage under their terms.

datasets.name: StarCoder Data
datasets.notes: Gated; same conditions as The Stack.

datasets.name: CodeSearchNet
datasets.version: pin at download (Hugging Face revision sha)
datasets.notes: Could not read the dataset card; verify license before any use.

datasets.name: CommitPack
datasets.notes: Good for 'fix this code' style data (CommitPackFT subset).

datasets.name: CodeContests
datasets.notes: Train split for ARO Code; test split kept for evaluation only.

datasets.name: MBPP
datasets.notes: Benchmark — never train on it (contamination).

datasets.name: HumanEval
datasets.notes: Benchmark — evaluation only.

datasets.name: SWE-bench
datasets.license_checked: hf-api 2026-11-22: no license tag; MIT on github.com/SWE-bench/SWE-bench
datasets.notes: Measures the GitHub agent (aro-agent). Evaluation only.

datasets.name: GSM8K
datasets.notes: Train split for ARO Research; test split for evaluation only.

datasets.name: MATH (competition_math)
datasets.notes: Disabled on Hugging Face after a takedown notice. Do not use copies.

datasets.name: NuminaMath-CoT
datasets.notes: Apache tag, but solutions were rewritten by a commercial model whose terms restrict training competing models. Needs legal review.

datasets.name: OpenWebMath
datasets.notes: No license tag on the hub; underlying web pages keep their copyright.

datasets.name: ARC (AI2 Reasoning Challenge)
datasets.notes: Benchmark; share-alike — evaluation only.

datasets.name: BIG-bench
datasets.notes: Contains a canary string; evaluation only.

datasets.name: AfriMGSM
datasets.notes: Math reasoning in African languages — evaluation.

datasets.name: arXiv
datasets.license: per-paper (often arXiv non-exclusive license); metadata CC0
datasets.notes: Search and cite at answer time (RAG). Only CC-BY papers could ever be trained on.

datasets.name: OpenAlex
datasets.notes: Scholarly metadata for research lookup.

datasets.name: Semantic Scholar
datasets.notes: API terms apply; attribution required.

datasets.name: PubMed / PMC Open Access
datasets.license: abstracts: publisher copyright; PMC OA subset: per-article CC licenses
datasets.notes: RAG with citations; medical answers need extra safety review.

datasets.name: UCI Machine Learning Repository
datasets.notes: Check each dataset's license individually.

datasets.name: COCO
datasets.license: annotations cc-by-4.0; images: Flickr terms per image
datasets.notes: Annotations are fine; images keep Flickr owners' rights.

datasets.name: Open Images V7
datasets.license: annotations cc-by-4.0; images listed as cc-by-2.0
datasets.notes: Google does not guarantee image licenses; keep per-image attribution.

datasets.name: Visual Genome
datasets.notes: Images come from COCO/Flickr with their own rights.

datasets.name: ImageNet
datasets.notes: Non-commercial terms of access.

datasets.name: Wikimedia Commons
datasets.license: per file (CC0, CC-BY, CC-BY-SA, public domain…)
datasets.notes: Filter to CC0/CC-BY/public-domain files only and keep attribution.

datasets.name: Ego4D
datasets.notes: Access requires a license agreement for research use.

datasets.name: ActivityNet
datasets.license: annotations only; videos are YouTube content
datasets.notes: Videos are third-party YouTube content.

datasets.name: Mozilla Common Voice
datasets.license_checked: manual: commonvoice.mozilla.org datasets page (CC0); HF mirror has no license tag
datasets.notes: Download from Mozilla's site; do not try to identify speakers.

datasets.name: LibriTTS
datasets.notes: TTS training.

datasets.name: WAXAL
datasets.version: pin at download (Hugging Face revision sha)
datasets.notes: Request access and read the license before use.

datasets.name: GigaSpeech
datasets.license: apache-2.0 tag; access via terms of use
datasets.notes: Gated; audio comes from podcasts/YouTube — read the access terms.

datasets.name: MUSAN
datasets.notes: Noise/music for augmentation; per-file licenses.

datasets.name: VoxPopuli
datasets.notes: European Parliament data; check the raw audio terms.

datasets.name: AudioSet
datasets.license: annotations cc-by-4.0; audio is YouTube content
datasets.notes: Audio itself is not distributed.

datasets.name: LAION-5B / Re-LAION
datasets.notes: Links to copyrighted web images; the original release was withdrawn in 2023 for safety reasons. Do not use.

datasets.name: Conceptual Captions
datasets.license: dataset terms allow use; images: third-party copyright
datasets.notes: Image URLs point to copyrighted content.

datasets.name: WebVid
datasets.notes: Taken down after a takedown request from the stock-footage owner.

datasets.name: Open X-Embodiment
datasets.notes: Robotics data — no ARO model uses it today.

datasets.name: SMOL (low-resource translation)
datasets.notes: Main ARO Translate training source for African languages.

datasets.name: AfriBERTa Corpus
datasets.notes: Monolingual text — language identification and fluency.

datasets.name: MasakhaNER 2.0
datasets.notes: Named entities in African languages.

datasets.name: AfriXNLI
datasets.notes: Understanding benchmark — evaluation only.

datasets.name: FLORES+
datasets.notes: Standard translation benchmark — evaluation only.

datasets.name: Belebele
datasets.notes: Reading comprehension in 120+ languages — evaluation only.

datasets.name: WMT24++
datasets.notes: Kept for evaluation to stay comparable with published results.

datasets.name: MAFAND-MT
datasets.notes: Non-commercial license.

datasets.name: Tatoeba MT
datasets.notes: Gated; small for African languages.

datasets.name: OPUS-100
datasets.notes: Mix of OPUS corpora with different licenses; license tag 'unknown'.

datasets.name: AfroLM corpus
datasets.notes: Read the repository license and data sources before use.

datasets.name: African Storybook
datasets.notes: Filter to CC-BY stories only.

datasets.name: HausaVG
datasets.notes: Non-commercial license.

datasets.name: ARO identity seed
datasets.notes: Teaches every text model that it is an ARO model.

datasets.name: ARO user feedback
datasets.license: user content, used under opt-in consent
datasets.quality: rated by users; scrubbed of personal data
datasets.notes: Only ARO-served, rated answers and corrections (aro_training.export).

datasets.name: ARO evaluation sets
datasets.notes: Fixed test sets used to accept or reject new versions.
